title.narrative: Anticipation Alert for the susceptible landslide in Balaucha and Owa area of Aalital Rural Municipality, Dadeldhura district, Nepal

description.narrative: High-risk of landslides Marginalized (Dalit, single women headed, Poor, Senior Citizen, PNS - People with special need)

The project is targeted towards anticipatory action targeting the landslide prone area of Balaucha and Oba areas of Aalital Rural Municipality in Dadeldhura district, Sudurpaschim province of Nepal. There was a huge landslide in that area in 15 August,2020. Right after that Department of Mines and Geology conducted the quick survey and the result indicated that the area is highly susceptible and the high risks need to be relocated. Recently, under the START Network, Analysis for Action Grant, a detailed study of the landslide of Balaucha and Oba has undertaken to study landslide susceptibility and HH vulnerability to know the risks. The study report showed that the settlement area of Oba is at high level of susceptibility and region near the crown of Balaucha is highly susceptible to sliding as well. The depth of landslide mass of Balaucha was estimated to be around 32 m and volume was 4.35 million cubic meters. Similarly, in Oba the depth was estimated around 53 m and volume was 2.81 million cubic meter. The assessment revealed that the primary triggering factors of the landslides are geological and rainfall. The vulnerability of HHs in the settlements of Balaucha and Oba revealed that out of the 48 houses in Balaucha, 13 houses are at high risk, 20 houses at medium risk and 15 houses at low risk to landsliding. Similarly in Oba, out of a total of 9 HHs, 6 houses were mapped at high risk, 2 houses at medium risk and 1 house at low risk. In conclusion, the study suggests that the families currently living in the landslide are exposed to the potential landslide hazard. To safeguard lives, it is best to relocate families to a nearby safer place. While the region of Balaucha and Oba can be used for agriculture purpose such as orchard and/or vegetables, among others. In present context, Nepal is experiencing late monsoon rains and as per Department of Hydrology and Meterology (DHM) of Nepal, Aalital RM and Dadeldhura will experience continuous rainfall over next 3 days. Beside there is continuous rainfall in past days and it is expected that there will be more rain. As the study suggests, the high possibility of excessive rain will very likely trigger the sliding of the already unstable land in Balaucha and Oba, it is very important to act now to relocate the high risk and medium risk HHs, a total of 41 HH to safer location in coordination of local government.
To save the lives of people who have been living in areas at high risk of landslides during the monsoon season.
